source_edition: Spiritual Health and Life-Orientation Measure — original ideals/lived
study_population: Students, adults, health-care and general cohorts
edition_validation_evidence: Fisher 2010 original four-domain 20 concepts, TWO response sets (40 ratings).
qualification_and_safety: Original instrument; SWBQ is lived half only; not a 40-unique-item test. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: SHALOM-G — generic transcendental wording variant
edition_validation_evidence: Fisher 2013 tested the generic Transcendent wording (4 of 5 transcendental items altered).
qualification_and_safety: Different wording from 2010 God-referenced form; avoid collapsing versions or spiritual/religious assumptions. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: SHALOM-G-CZ — Czech secondary-school validation
edition_validation_evidence: Czech adaptation; four-factor structure and age/gender reliability evaluated in each half.
qualification_and_safety: Czech youth evidence only; cannot extrapolate to Czech adults or RU/ES. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: SHALOM — Brazilian Portuguese children/adolescents
edition_validation_evidence: Valdivia/Alves/Rocha online 2018, print 2020; Brazilian Portuguese validated.
qualification_and_safety: Minors study: not adult norms; consent/safeguards and permission required. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Spiritual Well-Being Questionnaire — lived experience only
study_population: Original Australian validation of spiritual well-being factor structure
edition_validation_evidence: Gomez & Fisher 2003 original development/validation of SWBQ four-domain 20 items.
qualification_and_safety: SWBQ is lived component; SHALOM also separately measures ideals. Do not count SHALOM as SWBQ duplicate. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Religious and Spiritual Struggles Scale — original
study_population: US adults and undergraduate development samples (N400/483/1141)
edition_validation_evidence: Exline et al. 2014 developed and validated 26 items / six domains.
qualification_and_safety: Psychospiritual difficulty measure, not clinical diagnosis; avoid religion-biased interpretation. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Religious and Spiritual Struggles Scale — short 14
study_population: US participant samples in source development
edition_validation_evidence: Exline et al. 2022 original short form: 14 items, 6 dimensions (2–3 per factor).
qualification_and_safety: Not equivalent to RSS-26 scores; separate validation and cutoffs. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Religious and Spiritual Struggles Scale-14 — Poland
study_population: Polish respondents in three validation studies
edition_validation_evidence: Falewicz et al. 2023 replicated six-factor 14-item form, reliability/nomological evidence.
qualification_and_safety: Polish version validated independently; no commercial licensing inferred from OA article. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Religious and Spiritual Struggles Scale-14 — Russian Orthodox women
study_population: 593 cross-sectional + 476 longitudinal Russian-speaking Orthodox women age 18+
edition_validation_evidence: Shankov/Böttche/Lotzin 2026; two cohorts, six factors, author-approved translation; form in supplement.
qualification_and_safety: Evidence RESTRICTED to self-selected Orthodox Christian women; NOT proven for all Russian speakers, men or non-Orthodox people. Author approval for academic adaptation does not grant SaaS license. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Religious/Spiritual Struggles Scale — Puerto Rican Spanish 25-item model
edition_validation_evidence: Cumba-Avilés/Pagán-Torres 2023; 25-item scored model replicates six domains.
qualification_and_safety: NOT literal 26-item English original; regional ES-PR validation only. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Religious and Spiritual Struggles Scale — Portugal
edition_validation_evidence: Tomás/Moreira 2023 online / 2024 print, six-factor validation with author-authorized research translation.
qualification_and_safety: Adolescent subgroup needs distinct safeguards. Research translation permission not commercial license. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Religious and Spiritual Struggles Five-Factor Scale — Turkish
edition_validation_evidence: Şahin/Bilge 2026 Turkish adaptation of 22-item FIVE-factor RSS excluding Demonic.
qualification_and_safety: Never equate with full RSS-26 or RSS-14 six-factor form. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Daily Spiritual Experience Scale Short Form — Russian 6-item
edition_validation_evidence: Shankov et al. 2025 validation; adapted 6-item study form, one-factor EFA/CFA.
qualification_and_safety: Short DSES is NOT the 16-item DSES. Religious-culture and gender limits; research author permission is not for-profit rights. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Daily Spiritual Experience Scale Short Form — Russian 7-item expanded
study_population: 1056 Russian-speaking Orthodox Christian women; SAME study as 6/4
edition_validation_evidence: Russian adaptation validated with added closeness-to-God question; single factor.
qualification_and_safety: Not an independent population from RU-6/RU-4; no unqualified norms. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Daily Spiritual Experience Scale Short Form — Russian theistic 4-item
study_population: 1056 Russian-speaking Orthodox Christian women; SAME study as 6/7
edition_validation_evidence: Shankov et al. 2025 tested 4 explicitly God-referential items; less positive-affect content overlap.
qualification_and_safety: Not suitable for atheistic/non-theistic general profile by default; no universal comparability. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: FACIT Spiritual Well-Being — standalone 12-item scale
edition_validation_evidence: FACIT.org official measure v4: 12 items, 3 domains, paper/electronic.
qualification_and_safety: FACIT official: license required even when English use fee may be zero; commercial per-measure fees and approved translations. DO NOT USE until agreement. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: FACIT Spiritual Well-Being — full 39-item instrument
edition_validation_evidence: FACIT.org official 39-item FACIT-Sp version4; FACIT-Sp-12 is its spiritual subscale, NOT another complete 39.
qualification_and_safety: FACIT license and licensed translations required; clinical setting, no independent score norms here. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: WHOQOL Spirituality Religion Personal Beliefs — 32-item module
study_population: Adult populations; WHO multi-centre field-test context
edition_validation_evidence: WHO 2012 original SRPB 32-item supplemental module (field-test usually combined with WHOQOL-100).
qualification_and_safety: WHO official WHOQOL permission form required; module not asserted as stand-alone WHOQOL-100 or WHOQOL-BREF. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: WHOQOL-SRPB — Brazilian Portuguese validation
edition_validation_evidence: Panzini et al. 2011: PT-BR eight-factor SRPB validation.
qualification_and_safety: Permission via WHO still required; this is Brazilian locale-specific evidence. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Multidimensional Inventory of Religious/Spiritual Well-Being — original
edition_validation_evidence: Unterrainer et al. 2010 Diagnostica original German 48-item six-scale inventory.
qualification_and_safety: DOI/article access does not license exact instrument or online paid delivery. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Multidimensional Inventory for Religious/Spiritual Well-Being — short
edition_validation_evidence: Fuchshuber/Unterrainer 2021 confirmed four correlated factors in German-speaking sample.
qualification_and_safety: Short form loses Hope Transcendent and Experiences of Sense/Meaning from 48-item form; cannot compare subscales naïvely. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: MI-RSWB-48 — Persian Iranian psychiatric outpatient validation
edition_validation_evidence: Atoofi et al. online 2020 48-item Iranian validation; hope-transcendent subscale alpha only 0.33.
qualification_and_safety: Low HT reliability: caution; clinical population cannot generalize to all Farsi speakers. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: Spiritual and Religious Attitudes in Dealing with Illness — full
study_population: German adult patients with chronic diseases
edition_validation_evidence: Büssing 2010 contextual full 15-item three-factor instrument.
qualification_and_safety: Illness-specific tool, not generic spirituality inventory; copyright/digital commercial rights unverified. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.

source_edition: SpREUK Short Form — spiritual search/trust and reflection
study_population: 496 German adults with chronic disease (84% chronic pain)
edition_validation_evidence: Büssing 2010: 10-item 3-factor short version, distinct from full 15 items.
qualification_and_safety: No score equivalence to full version; no commercial hosted rights established. Research metadata only; no instrument items, scoring algorithms, normative cutoffs or production activation.
